newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bids in Portugal bond auction seen at mkt levels.
newsitem.headline: Bids in Portugal bond auction seen at mkt levels.

text.p: Bids in the Portuguese Treasury's five-year bond auction today should be in line with secondary market levels at between 6.10 and 6.20 percent.

At the previous auction, on March 25, The Treasury's Credit Institute placed all 25 billion escudos on offer at an average weighted 6.4288 percent. The Credit Institute is offering 25 billion in today's auction.
"There will be good demand between secondary market levels of 6.13 percent and 6.20 percent. The Treasury won't accept bids above this level," said one director of fixed-rate debt.
The results of the auction are due by 1000 GMT.
